# Camp Ally: Adelaide

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Jan 28, 2024
- 2 min read

Updated: Dec 10, 2024

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_ec06a2a0cdc540d38427b6e5ae115fd9~mv2.png)

Image Credit: __DSJ__

#### **Type**

Lite Ally

Lite Allies do not offer a daily/repeatable quest, they are most often vendors and offer buffs in return for you letting them sleep at your camp.

#### **Specialises in**

"I'm a Showgirl Darling"

#### **Faction**

N/A

#### **Lore**

Adelaide's background can be found here.

#### **Camp Item**

Adelaide's Table

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_42e2dccf907940cb8089de73586b85e3~mv2.png)

#### **Flamingo Units**

2x Flamingo Units

Flamingo Unit camp item cost __spreadsheet__ 

#### **Obtainable from**

- Season 16 scoreboard - (free)
- Gold Bullion - Samuel at Foundation once you have reached Ally status with the Settlers (4000 Gold Bullion)

**Daily Quest**

N/A

**Buffs/Services**

24-hour cool down period on all buffs and services excluding the Well Rested/Lover's Embrace buff.

Well Rested

+5% XP for three hours

Human/Robot Interfacing

Take 25% less damage from robots and do +15% damage against robots for one hour.
